task_description: Implement four deferred features in the Expo/React Native Web POS CRM worktree: (1) Supplier master store + web CRUD screen + wire stock-receive picker to the store; (2) Brand store + web CRUD screen + make product brand pickers read from the store; (3) persist the mobile product add/edit flow into productStore; (4) build the real web Sync settings screen bound to syncStore and replace the placeholder. All UI in Thai, design-system tokens honored, mock-only (no real server), product-variant matrix explicitly out of scope.
